privateVars.name: server
privateVars.description: Socket.IO server instance for broadcasting events

privateVars.name: secret
privateVars.description: Encoded NEXTAUTH_SECRET used for JWT verification of WebSocket connections

functions.name: handleConnection
functions.description: Authenticates WebSocket connections by extracting and verifying a JWT token from the Authorization header or query params, then joins the user to their room

functions.name: handleDisconnect
functions.description: Logs when a WebSocket client disconnects

functions.name: sendToUser
functions.description: Emits a WebSocket event with payload to all active connections of a specific user's room

functions.name: extractToken
functions.description: Extracts a JWT token from the Authorization header (Bearer scheme) or query parameter
